extracted.name: Sheet Pan Banana Pancakes
extracted.description: Our Sheet Pan Banana Pancakes are soft, fluffy and baked to golden perfection in one pan with no flipping required.
ingredient_lines: 350 grams all-purpose flour about 2 ¾ cup
50 grams granulated sugar about ¼ cup
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 425F and spray a large sheet pan with non-stick spray. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together your dry ingredients: all-purpose flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Add in the milk, beaten eggs, banana, melted butter and vanilla extract. Mix well until there are no lumps.

Spread pancake batter evenly on prepared sheet pan and bake for 14 minutes or until a toothpick comes out with moist crumbs from the center; the tops will just start to get a light golden color. Slice into 12 portions (or as desired) and serve warm with your favorite pancake toppings.
